title: Echoes of Adventure: Radial Menu
description: A highly customizable radial menu for Minecraft. Easily bind commands and keybindings to a visual wheel with a built-in GUI editor and per-world configurations.
body:
**Echoes of Adventure: Radial Menu** is a highly customizable utility mod for Forge that streamlines your gameplay. Instead of memorizing dozens of keybindings or repeatedly typing chat commands, you can now access everything through an intuitive, animated radial wheel.

## ✨ Key Features
- **12-Slot Radial Wheel**: A perfectly balanced radial interface supporting up to 12 unique buttons for your most-used actions.
- **Two Action Types**:
  - **Commands**: Execute any console command (e.g., /home, /spawn, or complex mod-specific commands) instantly.
  - **Keybindings**: Simulate any keypress. This allows you to bind functions from other mods (like opening a backpack or using an ability) directly to the wheel.
- **In-Game GUI Editor**: No more messing with config files. Add, remove, and reorder your buttons through a user-friendly interface.
- **Searchable Icon & Key Pickers**:
  - **Item Icon Picker**: A dedicated screen to search and select any item from the game to use as a visual icon for your button.
  - **Keybinding Picker**: Easily find and assign existing game controls to the menu via a searchable list.
- **Intelligent World Profiles**: The mod automatically detects whether you are on a Multiplayer server (by IP) or a Singleplayer world and saves a unique layout for each environment.
- **Global Templates**: Create a "Master Layout," save it as a default, and apply it to any new world or server with a single click.

## ⚙️ Configuration & Customization
The mod includes a client-side config (`echoesofadventure-radialmenu-client.toml`) where you can fine-tune the experience:
- **Activation Mode**: Choose how you interact with the wheel—trigger actions on **Click**, on **Hover**, or **Both**.
- **UI Settings**: Toggle the visibility of the settings directly on the radial menu.
